# A first look at DeepSeek V4

I read the announcement so you do not have to. DeepSeek V4 was announced on 2026-09-30 and the headline number is its size: 1.2 trillion total parameters, which makes it the largest model the lab has announced.

There is no model to download yet. The lab promises weights in the coming weeks, and until then everything is based on what the lab wrote. I would not trust any benchmark number you see circulating this week.

What I find interesting is the plan for a smaller distilled variant. If it is close to the big model in quality it will matter more to most people than the 1.2T model itself, which few can run.

I will update this post when the weights land. Until then, treat everything about V4 as announced, not released.
